G.short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
G.purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
G.expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
G.progress_note: G8.5 remains ACCEPTED on exact-Windows tested head 6cc0c2b5ff1bc21a5b488a8492ef8cce28fa4736. G8.6 first Windows attempt exposed and FIX1 corrected a harness-only JSON numeric Array comparison. The second exact-Windows attempt on 666a56e104b521c642afd3168f9d3e3b3f1d9ad4 passed editor import, G8.5 parent invariance (150 assertions) and G8.6 contracts (35 assertions), then the real 561-sample headless lab failed because river_channel_delta_m was zero throughout the corridor. Root cause is presentation-corridor alignment, not canonical geomorphology: the accepted G6 river spline around the PX/PZ seam carries roughly +70 m radial elevation above Fixture.RADIUS_M, while the original lab forced the seam center and every sample onto the body reference sphere. Since G6 correctly measures full 3D distance to centerline, no sample entered the river channel. FIX2 adds a presentation-only wrapper that locates the seam on the same radial interpolation used by G6, preserves the real G6 centerline radius and samples the corridor on that radius. Base G8.6 presentation logic and all accepted G8.1-G8.5 geomorphology runtimes/formulas remain unchanged; the headless smoke still requires every deformation component to be visible. Focused FIX2 retest, automated world/core regression and manual graphical acceptance remain required.
G.next_stage: Sync latest feature/g8-geomorphology and rerun RUN_G8_6_GEOMORPHOLOGY_VISUAL_LAB_TESTS.ps1. If green, keep the exact clean checkout and run RUN_G8_6_AUTOMATED_ACCEPTANCE.ps1 without fetch/reset. Then launch the G8.6 scene and complete the manual graphical checks. Only automated plus manual PASS unlocks G8 Full Acceptance.
